entities.name: Václav Láska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Václav Jan Láska was a Czech geodesist, astronomer, geophysicist and mathematician. He was based mainly at Charles University, and was the founding director (1920–1933) of the State Institute of Geophysics, which later became the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences.

entities.summary: Václav Jan Láska was a Czech geodesist, astronomer, geophysicist and mathematician. He was based mainly at Charles University, and was the founding director (1920–1933) of the State Institute of Geophysics, which later became the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences.
